name: Purple Worm

actions.name: Bite
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be swallowed. Swallowed creatures are blinded, restrained, and take 5d10 acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 20 damage from inside, it regurgitates.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or take full poison damage. On success, half poison damage.

actions.name: Tunneling Charge
actions.effect: The worm burrows underground and erupts beneath its target. All creatures within 3m of the eruption point must pass PHYS save or take damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Thrash
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack, the worm's body convulses. All creatures within 3m must pass PHYS save or take 3d10 bludgeoning and be pushed 6m.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: Can burrow through solid rock, leaving a 3m diameter tunnel. Moves through earth at full speed.

traits.name: Tremorsense
traits.desc: Can detect creatures touching the ground within 30m.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Deals double damage to objects and structures.

lore: Purple Worms are among the most terrifying subterranean predators, massive burrowing beasts that can swallow a horse whole. Their tunnels riddle the Underdark, and entire settlements have been consumed when a Purple Worm erupts from below.
